# FSx for ONTAP as a Container Data Store — ECS / EKS Patterns

> Reference architecture, CloudFormation templates, and literature-based verification for using
> Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP as the persistent data store for containerized workloads on
> Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS, across both EC2 and AWS Fargate launch types. It covers five access
> forms — NFS and SMB host mounts on ECS on EC2, NetApp Trident persistent volumes (NFS and iSCSI)
> on EKS on EC2, and S3 Access Points object access on Fargate — including workloads replatformed
> with AWS Transform containerization. Current state: literature review plus CloudFormation with
> static validation (cfn-lint); live deployment is the next stage.

## How to read this repository

Japanese under `docs/ja/` is the primary, authoritative version; `docs/en/` mirrors its section
structure. The reach form to FSx for ONTAP differs by launch type, and the repository keeps the
distinction explicit: EC2 launch types mount files (NFS, SMB, or iSCSI persistent volumes), while
Fargate cannot mount a volume and reaches the data as objects through S3 Access Points. Each claim
carries an evidence tag — reproduced here, stated in vendor or AWS documentation, or unverified — and
the templates are passed through cfn-lint only, not deployed, which the documents say inline rather
than imply.

## Overview

- [README (Japanese)](README.md): Primary hub — the five-pattern fit table, the three migration
  approaches that land data on FSx for ONTAP, and the trade-off between EC2 and Fargate launch types.
- [README (English)](README.en.md): English hub mirroring the Japanese structure.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Conventions, naming rules, and quality gates for coding agents.

## Patterns and verification

- [Container-target FSx for ONTAP data-store verification (Japanese)](docs/ja/atx-containerization-fsxn-storage-verification.md):
  Feasibility of the access forms across ECS/EKS on EC2 and Fargate, each turned into a
  CloudFormation template and taken through static validation, with the deploy prerequisites,
  ordering, and pitfalls stated as unverified until live deployment.
- [Container-target FSx for ONTAP data-store verification (English)](docs/en/atx-containerization-fsxn-storage-verification.md):
  English mirror of the verification record.
- [ECS on EC2 mount of FSx for ONTAP (Japanese)](docs/ja/ecs-ec2-fsxn-mount.md): The ECS on EC2
  host-mount path at procedure level — AWS's NFS/SMB host-mount method, plus a documentation-based
  assessment of running NetApp Trident as a container on ECS on EC2, with confidence recorded
  separately per claim.
- [ECS on EC2 mount of FSx for ONTAP (English)](docs/en/ecs-ec2-fsxn-mount.md): English mirror of
  the mount procedure.

## Migration approaches and derivation

- [Containerization derivation and FSx for ONTAP compatibility (Japanese)](docs/ja/atx-containerization-fsxn-derivation.md):
  Why AWS Transform containerization and the FSx for ONTAP persistent-volume path are separate
  mechanisms, how the EKS data path uses NetApp Trident (NFS `ontap-nas` and iSCSI `ontap-san`
  drivers) rather than AWS Transform, which .NET sources are in scope for modernization, and the
  multiprotocol property shared across the migration routes.
- [Containerization derivation and FSx for ONTAP compatibility (English)](docs/en/atx-containerization-fsxn-derivation.md):
  English mirror of the derivation document.

## CloudFormation templates

- [ECS on EC2 + NFS host mount](templates/containers-ecs-ec2-fsxn-nfs.yaml): Mounts an SVM NFS
  junction on the EC2 container instance and bind-mounts it into the task.
- [ECS on EC2 (Windows) + SMB](templates/containers-ecs-ec2-fsxn-smb.yaml): SMB global mapping on a
  Windows container instance, bind-mounted into the task; references an existing directory.
- [EKS on EC2 + NetApp Trident](templates/containers-eks-ec2-fsxn-trident.yaml): EKS cluster, managed
  node group, and the Trident add-on provisioning NFS (`ontap-nas`) and iSCSI (`ontap-san`)
  persistent volumes.
- [ECS on Fargate + S3 Access Points](templates/containers-ecs-fargate-fsxn-s3ap.yaml): Object access
  to FSx for ONTAP through S3 Access Points for a Fargate task (application uses the S3 SDK).
- [EKS on Fargate + S3 Access Points](templates/containers-eks-fargate-fsxn-s3ap.yaml): Object access
  to FSx for ONTAP through S3 Access Points for an EKS on Fargate pod (application uses the S3 SDK).
- [Parameter examples](params/): One `*.example.json` per template; real values stay outside version
  control.

## Hub and related

This repository is a spoke of the Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP knowledge hub. General ONTAP knowledge
is cross-linked there, not duplicated here.

- [Hub: FSx for ONTAP Adoption Playbook — llms.txt](https://github.com/Yoshiki0705/FSx-for-ONTAP-Adoption-Playbook/blob/main/llms.txt):
  LLM-facing map of the hub knowledge base.
- [Hub: workload entry map](https://github.com/Yoshiki0705/FSx-for-ONTAP-Adoption-Playbook/blob/main/docs/ja/reference/workload-entry-map.md):
  How workloads map onto the hub's lifecycle and topic axes and onto the spoke repositories.

> **Block-volume note**: this repository covers Kubernetes block persistent volumes via the Trident
> iSCSI (`ontap-san`) driver. General ONTAP block-storage knowledge — persistent-volume limits,
> multipath, driver choice — lives in the Hub's related block-storage note rather than here.
